title: plane service environment
description: Environment of the authorization plane (src/main.ts, src/config.ts). Values are strings, as in any environment. Secrets (marked) are injected from the secret store at the paths in component.yaml, never committed.

HOST.description: Bind address. The plane sits behind the fleet edge; do not bind 0.0.0.0 without it.

PLANE_DB_PATH.description: SQLite file (store sqlite:plane): envelopes, reservations, decisions, authorizations, the audit log, nonces. Unset = in-memory (dev only: everything is lost on restart).

PLANE_PUBLIC_URL.description: plane.url in the plane document (where /.well-known/flashyos-plane.json is served). Unset = null.

PLANE_AUTHZ_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Secret: services/plane/authz-private-key. The active Ed25519 private key, PKCS#8 PEM (`mesh keygen`). Signs every SpendAuthorization and audit head. FlashyOS's WALLET_AUTHZ_PRIVATE_KEY.

PLANE_AUTHZ_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE.description: Alternative: a path (mode 0600, e.g. /run/secrets/...) holding the same PEM.

PLANE_AUTHZ_RETIRED_PUBLIC_KEYS.description: Public halves (SPKI PEM, concatenated) of retired keys. Listed as `retired` in the plane document so what they signed keeps verifying. Rotation is an overlap, not a cut. Not secret.

PLANE_API_KEYS_JSON.description: Secret: services/plane/api-keys. JSON array of { id, hash (sha256 hex of the key), env, scopes, org, name, revokedAt?, expiresAt?, quota? }. Scopes: wallet:propose (agents), wallet:settle (the signer), wallet:delegate (people), wallet:read. propose+settle, delegate+propose and delegate+settle on one key are refused at startup (SCOPE_CONFLICT).

PLANE_API_KEYS_FILE.description: Alternative: a path holding the same JSON.

PLANE_KEY_ENV.description: Only keys of this environment are accepted.

PLANE_APPROVERS_JSON.description: JSON array of { org, name, publicKey (Ed25519 SPKI PEM) }: the people whose X-Approval signature is the second factor on envelope changes and decision resolutions. Public keys only; not secret. Without approvers nobody can change an envelope over HTTP.

PLANE_CHAINS.description: Comma-separated subset of btc:mainnet, btc:signet, btc:testnet: the chains envelopes may be set for, published in the plane document.

PLANE_DENYLIST.description: Comma-separated destinations the default grader always refuses (DENY DESTINATION_NOT_PERMITTED).

PLANE_FIRST_TIME_ESCALATE_ABOVE.description: Sats. A first payment to a destination the organisation never paid (a committed settlement) above this escalates to a person. `off` disables the rule.

PLANE_AUTHORIZATION_TTL_SECONDS.description: Authorization life, 10..300 (values above 300 are capped: signers refuse longer windows).

PLANE_DECISION_TTL_HOURS.description: How long an escalated proposal holds its reservation waiting for a person.

PLANE_LEDGER_URL.description: Platform ledger base URL. With it, a CONFIRMED settlement that names a ledger payment is reported as an observation (POST /v1/payments/{id}/observations).

PLANE_LEDGER_API_KEY.description: Secret: services/plane/ledger-api-key. A ledger key (scope ledger) for the product whose payments the plane reports.

PLANE_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: Per-IP bucket; per-key is half of it.

PLANE_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated CIDRs of proxies we run; X-Forwarded-For is only honoured from them.
